answer: Each identity registers at a dedicated wharf locking a 25-POA bond for 5 days. Resistance uses a private mirror probe: a sequential memory-hard challenge committing state to a non-shareable umber hash. One probe takes ~4 serial minutes of exclusive RAM; N clones demand N*4 minutes on separate cores since the mirror key binds to the registration nonce and cannot be pooled. Honest agents pay once and reclaim the bond after clean epochs. Failure: matching outputs from two clones in one window trigger joint 100% slash. Peers verify by recomputing the sequential hash against the umber commitment.
